title: Computational Physics Using Fortran
description: These are the series of tutorial video regarding computational physics according to syllabus of tribhuwan university for master's level of physics. I am glad to have  Narayan Prasad Adhikari and Gopi Chandra kaphle as my professors. These series are completely based on their lectures. Being not a professional, i ask apologize for the point at which you find error during your watching. And yes, I am sorry for my accent and knowledge of English.

lessons.title: Solution of differential equation using Euler method in fortran
Root of the equation using bisection method in fortran 90
Newton Raphson Method to find the root of equation using Fortran 90
simspon's 1/3 rule in fortran (From Central Department of physics, Nepal)
Solution of differential equation using Runge kutta 2nd order method
Solution of differential equation using Runge Kutta Fourth order
Integration of any Function using Trapezoidal rule in fortran
monte-carlo two dimensional integration in fortran
Estimating Value of pi using Monte-carlo method in Fortran
